# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTERED_GAP_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong gap up (>0.4%) paired with elevated VIX (>22) often exhausts buying pressure, making a fade to the prior session close a high-probability short. This edge exists because in high volatility environments, significant gap ups frequently represent overextended buying that reverses toward prior session levels as liquidity rebalances.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the open price exceeds the prior session close by >0.4% (gap up) and the current VIX >22, enter short at the open price of the first 5-minute bar after market open.  
Exit: Chart-stop at the prior session high (or gap high), TP1 at the prior session close, runner trail 20% off high-water mark.  
Regime: Restricted to the first 30 minutes after open and only when VIX >22 (high-volatility environment).
